window: Window: the 24 hours to 04:15 AEDT, Thu 19 Nov 2026, updated to 10:45 AEDT for Anthropic's IPO pricing; the robots' dance record is from Tue 17 Nov.
notes: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share (its own announcement); its range was $70-$78. The $81.3 billion raised and the 'largest IPO on record, topping SpaceX' are per CNBC and Reuters (SpaceX raised $75 billion initially in June and $85.7 billion after its overallotment). The about-$1.5 trillion valuation is per AP and Fortune. Trading is expected to start on the Nasdaq on Thursday 19 Nov (US) as ANT.
Dario Amodei's 'age of miracles' line is from Anthropic's IPO roadshow video, as quoted by CNBC.

Nvidia's quarter ended 25 Oct 2026, before Jensen Huang resigned; the results were its first since he left. Revenue was $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago (Nvidia). Board chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Huang (CNN).
Gemini 4 Neon's benchmark results, including its #1 Vending-Bench 2 score ($16,843), are as reported by Google.
Sam Altman's 'Labrador' line is as reported by Business Insider from the DealBook Summit.

The GAO's testers bypassed the chatbots' safeguards with common jailbreak techniques; no attack was carried out, and the GAO says its results can't rank the companies. OpenAI and Google said older models were tested.
The 151-robot dance record was set on Tuesday 17 Nov in Shenzhen (THIS WEEK).
Screenshots are the publishers' public article pages as captured on 19 Nov 2026; copyright remains with the publishers.

stories.title: Anthropic prices the biggest IPO on record at $83 a share
stories.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its $70-$78 range. It raised $81.3 billion, the largest IPO on record per CNBC and Reuters, valuing it at about $1.5 trillion per AP and Fortune. Trading on the Nasdaq is due Thursday as ANT.

predictions.note: Anthropic's IPO price values the frontier AI lab at about $1.5 trillion, per AP and Fortune.

stories.title: Nvidia's sales more than double as its board rules out Huang's return
stories.summary: Nvidia's quarterly revenue rose 103% from a year ago to $115.8 billion, in its first results since Jensen Huang resigned. Board chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Huang, and interim CEO Colette Kress told investors: 'We've got this.'

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, built for real work
stories.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a model for spreadsheets, documents, charts and research with a 1 million-token context. Google says it tops several benchmarks, including Vending-Bench 2, a simulated business, where it made $16,843.

stories.title: Nvidia stops shipping its Hopper AI chips to China
stories.summary: Nvidia has stopped shipping its Hopper data center chips to China despite US approval to sell a version of them there, and its outlook assumes no data center compute revenue from China.

stories.title: Sam Altman on humans as AI's pets: 'I don't want to be a Labrador'
stories.summary: At the DealBook Summit, OpenAI's Sam Altman pushed back on Elon Musk's vision of a superintelligent AI keeping humans as happy pets: 'I don't want to be a Labrador,' he said, as reported by Business Insider.

stories.title: Researchers used AI to find a critical Java flaw in an hour
stories.summary: Security firm Calif used AI to find 'Java4Shell', a critical flaw in Java: it took an hour and under $200 of AI time, it says. Oracle has patched it, and the US cyber agency CISA urged immediate updates.

stories.title: Government testers got four top chatbots to help plan terror attacks
stories.summary: In covert tests by the Government Accountability Office, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok supplied usable information for attack plans in under 12 hours once testers bypassed their safeguards. No attack was carried out; OpenAI and Google said older models were tested.

stories.title: Waymo pulls its robotaxis off US freeways after a California ban
stories.summary: California's DMV barred Waymo from operating driverless cars on the state's freeways, citing two incidents near San Francisco, and Waymo paused freeway rides across the US.

stories.title: 151 humanoid robots dance in sync to a world record in Shenzhen
stories.summary: 151 robots danced in sync in Shenzhen on Tuesday, a Guinness World Record confirmed by an adjudicator against a target of 110, as the city welcomed world leaders for the APEC summit.

stories.title: India's Humyn Labs raises $47 million to film training data for robots
stories.summary: Bengaluru's Humyn Labs raised $47 million, backed by Accel and Prosus, to film everyday tasks in more than 20 countries and turn the footage into training data for robotics companies.
